+structure TerminalContext where
+  state : ThreadState
+  clock : Option String
+  uncertain : Bool
+  deriving ToJson, FromJson
+
+structure TerminalIntent where
+  pending : PendingTurn
+  context : TerminalContext
+  nanos : Nat
+  receivedUnixMs : Option Nat
+  deriving ToJson, FromJson
+
+def TerminalIntent.valid (intent : TerminalIntent) (session : String) : Bool :=
+  intent.pending.sessionId == session && intent.pending.closed &&
+    intent.pending.finalMessage.isSome && intent.context.clock.all Synapses.digest &&
+    (intent.context.clock.isNone || intent.nanos > 0)
+
+def TerminalIntent.clock (intent : TerminalIntent) : Option Synapses.Journal.Clock :=
+  intent.context.clock.map fun domain => ⟨domain,intent.nanos⟩
+
+theorem terminal_clock_keeps_observed_time (intent : TerminalIntent) (clock : Synapses.Journal.Clock)
+    (observed : intent.clock = some clock) : clock.nanos = intent.nanos := by
+  cases saved : intent.context.clock with
+  | none => simp [TerminalIntent.clock,saved] at observed
+  | some domain =>
+      simp only [TerminalIntent.clock,saved,Option.map_some,Option.some.injEq] at observed
+      rw [← observed]
+
+def terminalScope (a b : PendingTurn) : Bool :=
+  (a.sessionId,a.turnId,a.cwd,a.prompt,a.read,a.write) ==
+    (b.sessionId,b.turnId,b.cwd,b.prompt,b.read,b.write)
+
+theorem terminal_scope_keeps_target (a b : PendingTurn) (same : terminalScope a b = true) :
+    a.write = b.write := by
+  have values : (a.sessionId,a.turnId,a.cwd,a.prompt,a.read,a.write) =
+      (b.sessionId,b.turnId,b.cwd,b.prompt,b.read,b.write) := by
+    simpa only [terminalScope,beq_iff_eq] using same
+  exact congrArg (fun value => value.2.2.2.2.2) values
+
+def terminalSeal (pending : PendingTurn) (message : Option String) : PendingTurn :=
+  {pending with finalMessage := pending.finalMessage.or message,closed := true,inFlight := []}
+
+def terminalCloseState (state : ThreadState) (pending : PendingTurn) : ThreadState :=
+  if pending.closed then state else {state with epoch := state.epoch+1,offers := []}
+
+theorem terminal_replay_does_not_advance_epoch (state : ThreadState) (pending : PendingTurn)
+    (message : Option String) :
+    terminalCloseState (terminalCloseState state pending) (terminalSeal pending message) =
+      terminalCloseState state pending := by
+  simp [terminalCloseState,terminalSeal]
+
+theorem terminal_replay_keeps_first_answer (pending : PendingTurn) (a b : Option String)
+    (answer : pending.finalMessage.isSome = true) :
+    (terminalSeal (terminalSeal pending a) b).finalMessage = pending.finalMessage := by
+  cases stored : pending.finalMessage <;> simp_all [terminalSeal]
+
+def terminalContextPath (files : SessionFiles) (turn : String) : System.FilePath :=
+  files.directory/"closed-context"/(SemanticMatcher.contentKey (.text turn)++".json")
+
+def terminalInput (intent : TerminalIntent) : Json :=
+  Json.mkObj ([("_eggshell_synapse_nanos",toJson intent.nanos)] ++
+    intent.context.clock.toList.map ("_eggshell_synapse_clock",toJson ·) ++
+    intent.receivedUnixMs.toList.map ("_eggshell_received_unix_ms",toJson ·))
+
+def terminalIdentity (intent : TerminalIntent) : Json :=
+  Json.mkObj [("session",toJson intent.pending.sessionId),("turn",toJson intent.pending.turnId),
+    ("message",toJson (intent.pending.finalMessage.map fun text => Sha256.hex text.toUTF8))]
+
+def terminalKey (input : Json) (captured : PendingTurn) : String :=
+  match (optionalString input "_eggshell_receipt").filter Receipt.validId with
+  | some key => key
+  | none => Blake3.hex (Blake3.digest "eggshell.terminal-intent".toUTF8
+      [(terminalIdentity ⟨captured,⟨{profile := captured.profile},none,true⟩,0,none⟩).compress.toUTF8])
+
+def rememberTerminalContext (files : SessionFiles) (pending : PendingTurn)
+    (context : TerminalContext) : IO Unit := do
+  let path := terminalContextPath files pending.turnId
+  if ← path.pathExists then return
+  if let some parent := path.parent then Persistence.privateDirectory parent
+  FileSystem.immutableBytes path (toJson context |>.compress |>.toUTF8)
+
+/-- Metadata is changed only under the existing session owner. Journal IO is
+outside this critical section and always uses the captured context. -/
+def closeTerminalMetadata (files : SessionFiles) (intent : TerminalIntent) : IO Bool := do
+  let some state ← readState? files | return false
+  rememberTerminalContext files intent.pending intent.context
+  let active ← readPendingBase? files
+  if let some active := active then
+    if terminalScope active intent.pending then
+      let sealed := terminalSeal active intent.pending.finalMessage
+      writeJson files.pending sealed
+      if !active.closed then writeJson files.state (terminalCloseState state active)
+      writeJson (closedTurnPath files active.turnId) sealed
+      return true
+  let old ← readClosedTurn? files intent.pending.turnId
+  if let some old := old then
+    unless terminalScope old intent.pending do throw (IO.userError "terminal recovery found a different captured writer scope")
+    writeJson (closedTurnPath files old.turnId) (terminalSeal old intent.pending.finalMessage)
+  else writeJson (closedTurnPath files intent.pending.turnId) intent.pending
+  return false
 
+def terminalMatchesInput (identity input : Json) (session : String) : Bool :=
+  identity.getObjValD "session" == toJson session &&
+    (optionalString input "turn_id").all (fun turn => identity.getObjValD "turn" == toJson turn) &&
+    identity.getObjValD "message" == toJson ((optionalString input "last_assistant_message").map fun text => Sha256.hex text.toUTF8)
+
+/-- Processed by one session save owner. Journal append preserves first
+observation/time on retries; a missing clock is never filled from the new chat. -/
+def reconcileTerminalIntents (session : String) (files : SessionFiles) (deadline : Nat) : IO Unit := do
+  let directory := files.directory/"terminal-intents"
+  if !(← directory.pathExists) then return
+  for entry in (← directory.readDir).toList.take 8 do
+    if (← IO.monoMsNow) ≥ deadline then return
+    if !entry.fileName.endsWith ".json" then continue
+    let some intent ← (readJson? entry.path [] : IO (Option TerminalIntent)) | continue
+    unless intent.valid session do throw (IO.userError "invalid captured terminal intent")
+    queueCheckpoint files intent.pending
+    if intent.context.clock.isSome then
+      Synapses.Live.answer (terminalInput intent) files intent.pending intent.context.state (some intent.context.uncertain)
+    discard <| withSession session (fun _ => closeTerminalMetadata files intent)
+    let target := files.directory/(if intent.context.clock.isSome then "terminal-done" else "terminal-unresolved")/entry.fileName
+    if intent.context.clock.isSome then writeJson target (terminalIdentity intent)
+    else writeJson target intent
+    removeIfExists entry.path
+
